name: Site Grid Connector
author: Hibiscus Technolab

sections.description:
Site Grid Connector securely connects your WordPress site with the Site Grid platform, allowing centralized monitoring, updates, and synchronization.Manage multiple WordPress sites through a single dashboard

The plugin provides the following core features:

  • Secure REST API endpoints for site communication
  • Plugin, theme, and WordPress core update management
  • Site status and health reporting
  • Full site synchronization for updates
  • Token-based authentication for secure access

After installation, the plugin automatically registers REST API endpoints that allow authorized systems to retrieve site data and perform updates securely.

Usage

Once connected, Site Grid can:
– Fetch plugin, theme, and core status
– Perform authorized updates
– Sync site data securely

Short Description

The WP Site Grid Connector plugin is designed to securely link your WordPress installation with wpsitegrid.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your WordPress site
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Generate and copy the secure token from the plugin settings
  4. Connect your site to the Site Grid platform using the token
